title: Floating assistant chat bubble
observed_behavior: AssistantSidebar was mounted as a fixed right sidebar from web/src/routes/+layout.svelte.
Layout computed --assistant-sidebar-width from assistantUi.open and assistantUi.collapsed and applied it as main margin-right.
Assistant UI state used open/collapsed/activeSessionId in web/src/lib/stores/assistant.svelte.js.
intended_behavior: AssistantChat replaces AssistantSidebar as the layout-mounted assistant wrapper.
AssistantBubble remains available at bottom-right and toggles AssistantPanel without shifting main content.
AssistantPanel is a fixed overlay panel that reuses AssistantTurn and AssistantPlanApproval behavior through AssistantTurn.
Assistant UI state uses panelOpen/activeSessionId/hasUnread/lastDismissedAt and migrates the old localStorage shape.
